subject: Model variant phasing — critical path, owners, and customer notice draft
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Jul 2028 10:15:00 -0000
Subject: Model variant phasing — critical path, owners, and customer notice draft

Team —

Quick one to get alignment on the proposed phasing for the M-v2 family and to assign clear owners for the customer notice and technical roll. High level: we need a 90-day runway for customers on current endpoints, with a 30/60/90 comms cadence and a hard cut where the old endpoint is deprecated but read-only logs remain for 180 days (no token processing). I attached a first-pass timeline (phaseout_timeline_v1.xlsx) and a customer notice draft (customer_notice_draft.md).

Asks:
- Product (Marissa): finalize comms cadence and notice language, decide opt-out/legacy-exempt criteria by EOD Mon (09-Jul).
- Eng (Irene): confirm compatibility shim feasibility (cost/perf trade-offs) and ETA for enabling a temporary dual-serve lane. Need a risk assessment + mitigation by Tue (10-Jul).
- Sales/CS (Ben/Rachel): validate customer groups who must be notified first (top 20 accounts + enterprise), and flag any high-risk deals (procurement complexity).
- Legal/Procurement touch (Neha): any contract wording that requires a longer runway? flag exceptions process.

We have an active Helios AI renewal that touches this change (DEAL-3741). Ben — can you confirm their lead contact so we can share the draft notice?

I'll own the internal exec summary and the cross-functional roll call. If nobody objects, I'll send the first notice to the pilot cohort on Wed.

Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference
attachments: phaseout_timeline_v1.xlsx, customer_notice_draft.md
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Jul 2028 13:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Model variant phasing — critical path, owners, and customer notice draft

Thanks Vivek — I skimmed the assets. A couple quick clarifications:

1) Cadence: propose we do a 30-day pilot notice to ~10 low-risk customers, then 60-day broad notice, then final 14-day reminder before cut. That gives us more time to triage regressions.
2) Notice language: I prefer the "impact-first" opening: what changes, how it affects tokens/costs, actionable next steps + rollback contact. I can run the draft through comms ops and have a version ready by Mon EOD.
3) Exemptions: we should define an explicit exemption SLA (review within 5 business days) and a temporary access token for approved exemptions. That will reduce escalation noise.

I'll also add a short FAQ for sellers so they can quickly answer procurement questions. Ben/Rachel — will coordinate with you on the pilot list.

-Marissa

Subject: Re: Model variant phasing — critical path, owners, and customer notice draft

Vivek / Marissa —

Short version: a compatibility shim (proxy that translates v1 requests into v2-compatible inputs) is feasible as a short-term mitigation, but it has two main trade-offs: increased p99 latency (~15-25ms added on average) and operational complexity (requires additional autoscaling knobs and KV sync). I ran a quick pass against the compatibility_matrix.csv and flagged the heavy-risk model ops (layers that don't quantize cleanly).

Deliverables I can provide by Tue (10-Jul):
- Risk matrix highlighting customers likely to see quality regressions (CSV attached).
- Estimated infra delta (cost/% of traffic) for running dual-serve for a 90-day runway.
- A minimal rollback plan: feature flag + rate limit that allows 48-hour reversal window.

If Product wants to reduce risk more, we need to extend the pilot to 45 days or accept a narrower pilot cohort.

Irene

Date: Sun, 08 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -0000
Subject: Fwd: Helios AI - internal ask re: phasing / procurement

Forwarding Helios thread — Samir (ops) pinged me overnight. In short, they need: a) firm cutoff date for contract language, b) a single escalation point for regressions during migration, and c) clarification if any of their enterprise customers will be impacted by read-only logs policy.

Per our internal play: Helios is in the pilot cohort if we agree (they're large but technically validated). My read: they will want either a stronger exemption (longer runway) or a price protection clause if we cut sooner. Procurement already dropped a nod that legal will need to see proposed contract language.

Samir's email below.

--Ben

From: Samir Kapoor <samir@helios.ai>

Date: Sun, 08 Jul 2028 11:20:00 +0530
Subject: Helios: clarification on model phasing timeline and escalation

Ben,

Thanks for the heads-up. Two asks from Helios:
1) Can you confirm the exact dates for the 30/60/90 windows and the hard cutoff? We need something we can include in our SOWs.
2) During the pilot we need a single escalation contact (24/7 on-call) for anything that looks like a regression in production — will Redwood provide that or do we route back to our AM?

Also procurement will ask about any make-good or credit if there is a breaking regression caused by the phaseout. We prefer clarity now rather than surprises in renewal.

Samir

Hi Vivek / Team,

Appreciate the transparency. A couple of points from Helios:
- We can accept a pilot but need the pilot dates to be firm and a documented rollback SLA in case outputs materially regress for our customers.
- Procurement needs the notice for their SOWs today (we're on a tight internal procurement cycle).

If you can share the notice and the pilot window today, I can route to procurement and legal on our side and get back quickly.

To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 16:42:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Model variant phasing — critical path, owners, and customer notice draft

Thanks all for the rapid responses. Final decisions / owners below: 

1) Pilot cohort: Helios + 9 additional low-risk accounts (Ben/Rachel to share full list by EOD Mon). Pilot window: 2028-08-01 -> 2028-08-30 (30 days).
2) Broad notice: 2028-09-01 -> final cut 2028-11-01 (60-day broad notice + 30-day hard cut period).
3) Exemptions: Product will accept exemption requests and Legal (Neha) will review within 5 business days; temporary tokens can be provisioned for approved exemptions.
4) Escalation: Redwood will provide a dedicated on-call contact for pilot week 1 (rotating eng + AM). Irene will publish an on-call rota and 24/7 escalation playbook by Tue EOD.
5) Contract language / procurement: Neha, please prepare a one-paragraph SOW blurb and suggested credit/make-good language for procurement review.
6) Comms: Marissa will finalize the notice and FAQ by Mon EOD and share the Drive link; I'll approve and send pilot notices on Wed (2028-07-11 PST).

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_phaseout-plan (notice + FAQ + timeline). Attached assets are the ones sent earlier (phaseout_timeline_v1.xlsx, customer_notice_draft.md).

If no major objections, I'll convert this thread into a short exec note and schedule a 30-min sync for Wed morning to run through runbooks.

Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference
